endS: The seals are broken. Every housekeeper fell to dust and the house is yours again. Welcome home.

lv.s: Your family house was stolen by the housekeepers, your old friends, now cursed. Sneak through the garden, light the lanterns and find the keys.
Inside, the long hallway creaks. Read the old letters to learn the secret of the curse. Stay out of their sight.
The kitchen smells of burnt mint tea. Open the chests to recover your family's tools.
The library hides the forbidden book. Clean the mirrors to reveal the hidden pages.
In the riad's courtyard the fountain whispers. Light the lanterns to weaken the housekeepers.
The master's room. Break the four seals and the curse ends forever. Then take your home back.
